exposure: NDUFV1 compound heterozygosity (Arg40Gln, Val245Met missense variants)
cohort: Female siblings compound heterozygous for two missense variants (Arg40Gln, Val245Met) in NDUFV1, aged 6 and 14 years old, presenting with varying clinical manifestations of mitochondrial Complex 1 deficiency.
finding: The cases expand the phenotypic spectrum of NDUFV1-related mitochondrial Complex 1 deficiency, highlighting intrafamilial variability and offering insights into the management of associated life-threatening metabolic crises.
